definitions.explanation: The alarm clock feature that temporarily silences the alarm and rings again after a few minutes, or the act of using this feature.

examples.japanese: スヌーズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
スヌーズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧しまう。
examples.english: I keep hitting snooze over and over.

examples.japanese: スヌーズ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧すぎて、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I rely too much on the snooze function and nearly end up late every morning.

notes:
From English "snooze." Refers specifically to the alarm clock feature on smartphones and alarm clocks that delays the alarm by a set interval (usually 5-10 minutes). Very commonly used in everyday Japanese, especially when talking about morning routines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スヌーズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to hit snooze
- スヌーズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to stop the snooze
- スヌーズ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: snooze function
- スヌーズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set the snooze
- スヌーズ⟦{間隔|かんかく}→間隔：02622_kankaku⟧: snooze interval

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目覚|めざ}まし→目覚まし：08550_mezamashi⟧: alarm clock — the device or app itself
- ⟦アラーム→アラーム：10707_araamu⟧: alarm — the general alert sound or setting
- ⟦{二度寝|にどね}→二度寝：07694_nidone⟧: falling back asleep — going back to sleep after waking up, which snooze enables
